proof-statement-integrity.evidence: The block asserted an epistemic status it did not have, and I verified the counterexample by compiling it. Both the .lean and the .md's Discussion said the class 'deliberately has no instance: the conjecture's open state is visible in the type system', and explained that requiring Im z > 0 made 'any real-constant witness impossible'. The field concluded 'exists z : C, GeometricShape z' -- an existential unlinked to the root index k -- which is provable outright at z = i. Measured 2026-08-31, lean-direct exit 0: 'example (q x : R) (n : N) : SharedDenominatorCuspHolonomy q x n where cusp_complete_of_root := fun _ _ => <Complex.I, ...>' inhabits the class for EVERY q, x, n. Excluding real constants excluded the wrong constant. Still open after the repair: the Thurston gluing equations themselves -- GeometricShape carries only non-degeneracy and upper-half-plane, not Hol_mu = Hol_lambda = 1 -- and the md's biconditional, of which only the forward direction is encoded.
proof-statement-integrity.notes: Repair: shape : Fin n -> C is now a class PARAMETER, so the matched shape is caller-supplied and no constant discharges the class; it genuinely has no instance. Two projections removed. shared_denominator_cusp_holonomy was ':= h.cusp_complete_of_root' and now derives the three consequences of a geometric matched shape, none of which is the field. newton_seed_completeness was STATEMENT-IDENTICAL to it -- same binders, same conclusion, character for character -- while its docstring claimed 'the algebraic denominator zeros are valid Newton-Raphson seed values', a property with no seed, no iteration and no convergence anywhere in its type; removed, and the seeding claim stays in the .md with its two witnesses. New derived theorem seed_is_not_the_cusp_shape proves the md's own bounding finding: at a root index the matched shape is not real, so the bare seed q^-k is not the cusp shape -- which snappy-cusp-seeding.witness.json reaches by measuring 0.4-0.9 distance for m004, m003, L6a4. exists_geometricShape is kept as the regression guard for the trivialisation. Bean qou-z9ws.

trap-superlative.evidence: 'the zeros are the EXACT INITIAL SEED VALUES for the Newton-Raphson solver' is contradicted by the block's own later section, which reports the bare seeds 0.4-0.9 away from SnapPy's shapes and concludes 'the pole-to-cusp bijection cannot be a literal canonical identity'.
trap-superlative.notes: PROPOSED: drop 'exact' — 'are the initial seed values'. I recomputed the distance range from computations/snappy-cusp-seeding.witness.json across m004, m003 and L6a4: 0.4004 to 0.9148, so the block's own '0.4-0.9' is accurate and only 'exact' is not. SECOND ITEM: 'The solver converges in O(1) Newton steps per cusp ... instead of the O(log eps^-1) steps needed when starting from a generic universal z_q' is an unmeasured comparison — neither witness reports a generic-start baseline — and Newton's quadratic convergence makes an in-basin generic start O(log log 1/eps), not O(log 1/eps); the measured 9-11 iterations is consistent with either. EVERYTHING ELSE VERIFIES: Phi_n = 1/(x;q)_n with n simple zeros at x = q^{-k} for k = 0..n-1; the Faddeev limit (1-q) log Phi_n -> Li_2(x); the four-row algebraic/archimedean/geometric table is internally consistent; L6a4 is the Borromean rings (witness volume 7.327724753) and m004 and m003 both have volume 2.029883213 = Vol(4_1), with m004 shapes 0.5 +- 0.8660254i = exp(i pi/3). The block's honesty is exemplary: it states that the Lean class has NO instance and that a previous revision's fabricated z = 2 skeleton instance was removed.
